## 1. Feature Engineering Techniques Applied

* **`Discount_Ratio`:** Continuous numerical feature calculated as `Discount_Applied / Product_Price`. Captures promotional buying depth; high discount ratios strongly correlate with impulse purchasing and higher return rates.
* **`Size_Bracket_Flag`:** Binary indicator (`1` or `0`) generated by grouping identical `Customer_ID` session timestamps across apparel SKUs. Identifies "bracket buying" (purchasing multiple sizes of the same item with intent to return poor fits).
* **`Category_Risk_Score`:** Target-encoded continuous value replacing raw `Product_Category` strings with historical out-of-fold average return rates (e.g., Apparel = 0.29, Electronics = 0.08).
* **`Return_Reason_Length`:** Discrete numerical feature capturing word count in `Return_Reason` text, measuring customer dissatisfaction severity.
